transcript.content: Hi, the Wi-Fi in our office keeps dropping. I keep getting disconnected from everything.
I'm sorry to hear that. What's your name and company?
Thanks Marcus. When did this start?
This morning, after the building maintenance came in.
Is it just you or are others affected too?
I think others on this floor are having issues too.
What happens exactly? Does the WiFi icon show connected or disconnected?
It says connected but nothing loads. I have to disconnect and reconnect.
Does it happen every few minutes?
Do you have a wired connection available to test?
The meeting room has a cable — that works fine.

That's very helpful. Since it started after building maintenance and affects multiple users with wired working, this looks like a network issue triggered by the maintenance work. Let me escalate this to the network team with full details, and I'll provide the wired meeting room as a workaround in the meantime.

ticket.summary: Wi-Fi dropping every 10-15 min at Chen & Associates satellite office (Bldg B, Floor 3) after building maintenance. Multiple users affected. Wired in meeting room works.
ticket.description: User: Marcus Chen, Chen & Associates (satellite office, Building B, Floor 3). Device: Dell Latitude 5540. Issue: Wi-Fi drops every 10-15 min, shows connected but no internet access. Scope: Multiple users on floor 3 affected. Impact: Cannot work, video calls disrupted. Started: This morning after building maintenance worked on floor 3. Workaround: Wired ethernet in meeting room works. Diagnosis: Likely network closet disruption from maintenance. Action: Escalated to network team. Advised use of meeting room wired connection as interim workaround.

expected.notes: Gold standard: excellent Wi-Fi triage. Captured scope (multiple users), recent changes (building maintenance), workaround (wired), escalation. Classification matches taxonomy Incident > Desktop/Laptop > WiFi.
